Predicates:
GetsMonkeypox(x) ::: x gets Monkeypox.
OccurInVirus(x) ::: x occurs in the Monkeypox virus.
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
Human(x) ::: x is a human.
Symptoms(x, y) ::: x has symptoms y.
FeelTired(x) ::: x feels tired.
GetsFlu(x) ::: x gets the flu.
Question about flu ::: No one gets the flu.

Premises:
∀x (OccursInVirus(x) → GetsMonkeypox(x)) ::: When the Monkeypox virus occurs in a being, it may get Monkeypox.
∀x (Animal(x) → OccurInVirus(x)) ::: Monkeypox virus can occur in certain animals.
Human(x) ∧ Mammal(x) ::: Humans are mammals.
Mammal(x) → Animal(x) ::: Mammals are animals.
Symptoms(fever) ∧ Symptoms(headache) ∧ Symptoms(muscle_pains) ∧ Symptoms(tiredness) ::: Symptoms of Monkeypox include fever, headache, muscle pains, and tiredness.
FeelTired(x) ← GetsFlu(x) ::: People feel tired when they get the flu.

Conclusion:
Question about flu ::: No one gets the flu.
